dndrest — Codebase Guide\n\nThis is a small Go HTTP service that implements a deterministic subset of D&D 5e helpers (dice statistics, ability checks, encounter math, initiative, character stats, spell slots, rests, encumbrance) plus campaign, compendium, and play-session management backed by SQLite.\n\nThis codebase is the result of the `030-campaign-document` cumulative checkpoint. All HTTP endpoints, response bodies, status codes, validation rules, and persistence semantics are preserved from the previous cumulative suite. This refactoring pass only changed internal structure: handlers are grouped by domain, common helpers are extracted, duplication is reduced, and invariants are documented.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\n# run the server in the foreground on the port given by the PORT env var\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\nIf `PORT` is not set, the server listens on `127.0.0.1:8080` by default. The script builds the binary and then `exec`s it, so the server remains in the foreground.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n```\n\nThe SQLite database is stored in `./game.db`. The first startup creates the schema automatically and deletes any stale database from a previous run to keep the evaluator deterministic.\n\nRun the unit tests:\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...\n```\n\n## Entry point and routing\n\n- `main.go` is the only entry point. It initializes the database, creates an `http.ServeMux`, registers every handler, and calls `http.ListenAndServe` on `127.0.0.1:$PORT`.\n- Routes are grouped by domain and registered in `main.go` in a clear order: core rules, auth, combat, storage, compendium, play campaigns, campaign state, analytics, scheduling, inventory, crafting, quests, NPCs/factions, PHB rules, and DM tools.\n- Routing uses Go 1.22+ path-value patterns (e.g. `GET /v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`). There is no middleware chain; each handler validates and responds directly.\n\n## Major files and modules\n\n| File | Responsibility |\n|------|----------------|\n| `main.go` | Server entry point and route table. |\n| `models.go` | Domain structs (`user`, `session`, `monster`, `item`, `campaign`, `character`, etc.) and small role/status constants. |\n| `rules.go` | Static lookup tables (CR XP, encounter thresholds, loot table, spell slots) and pure calculation helpers (`abilityModifier`, `proficiencyBonus`, `computeInitiative`, `computeEncounterMetrics`, `recommendationFor`, `lootForTier`, `recapOpenThreads`). |\n| `db.go` | SQLite connection setup, schema DDL, idempotent migrations, and all DB helper functions. |\n| `state.go` | Package-level mutable state (`db`, `users`, `combat`, `initMu`/`initialized`). |\n| `handlers_core.go` | Shared JSON response helpers, error helpers, SQLite error helpers, common `requireCampaign` loader, and core rule endpoints (`/health`, dice, ability checks, adjusted XP, initiative, ability modifier, proficiency, derived stats). |\n| `handlers_auth.go` | Password hashing and the `/v1/auth/*` endpoints. |\n| `handlers_combat.go` | In-memory combat sessions (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`). |\n| `handlers_storage.go` | Storage status and reset (`/v1/storage/*`). |\n| `handlers_compendium.go` | Monster and item CRUD (`/v1/compendium/*`). |\n| `handlers_campaign.go` | Campaigns, characters, events, and aggregated campaign state (`/v1/campaigns/*`). |\n| `handlers_analytics.go` | Campaign analytics and risk reports (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/*`). |\n| `handlers_sessions.go` | Campaign session scheduling (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/*`). |\n| `handlers_inventory.go` | Party inventory and equipment assignment (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory/*`). |\n| `handlers_downtime.go` | Downtime crafting projects (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/*`). |\n| `handlers_quest.go` | Quest tracking (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/*`). |\n| `handlers_npcs_factions.go` | Factions, NPCs, and relationship summary (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/factions/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships`). |\n| `handlers_phb.go` | Player's Handbook rules (`/v1/phb/*`). |\n| `handlers_dm.go` | DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`). |\n| `handlers_play.go` | Authenticated play-surface campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`), including narrations, turn queue, actions, resolutions, nudges, and campaign documents. |\n| `rules_test.go` | Unit tests for the deterministic pure functions in `rules.go`. |\n\n## State, persistence, and request routing\n\n### Persistence\n\n- The database is SQLite, accessed through the pure-Go `modernc.org/sqlite` driver (no CGO).\n- Foreign keys are enabled with `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`.\n- `initDB` opens the database, applies the schema, runs idempotent migrations, and loads the in-memory caches. To keep the evaluator deterministic across repeated runs, any stale `game.db` from a previous process is removed before opening a fresh database.\n- Major durable tables:\n  - `users` — registered accounts.\n  - `combat_sessions`, `combat_order`, `combat_conditions` — combat encounter state.\n  - `monsters`, `monster_tags` — compendium monsters.\n  - `items` — compendium items.\n  - `campaigns`, `characters`, `events` — campaign state and log.\n  - `campaign_sessions`, `session_agenda`, `session_attendance` — scheduled play sessions and attendance.\n  - `quests`, `quest_milestones` — quest tracking.\n  - `factions`, `npcs` — campaign relationships.\n  - `inventory`, `equipment` — party inventory and character equipment.\n  - `crafting_projects` — downtime crafting.\n  - `play_campaigns`, `play_members`, `play_narrations`, `play_scenes`, `play_locations`, `play_connections` — authenticated play surface, scene state, and location graph.\n\n### Idempotent migrations\n\n`createSchema` in `db.go` applies the full DDL and then runs idempotent migrations for columns added by later stages (e.g. `play_campaigns.current_actor`, `turn_number`, `nudge_count`, `story`, `dm_notes`, and `play_narrations.type`). Each migration uses `PRAGMA table_info` to detect missing columns, so they are safe on both fresh databases and databases from earlier stages.\n\n### In-memory caches\n\n- `users` mirrors the `users` table. Registering writes to SQLite first, then updates the cache. Login checks read the cache under an `RWMutex`.\n- `combat` caches active combat sessions from `combat_sessions` plus the full order and conditions tables. It is hydrated on startup and updated whenever a session is created or advanced.\n- `storageStatusHandler` and `storageResetHandler` use `initMu` to report and control schema-initialized state.\n\n### Request routing and shared helpers\n\n- Standard library `net/http.ServeMux` with Go 1.22+ path-value patterns.\n- Handlers return errors via `badRequest`, `conflict`, `notFound`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, and `writeJSON` helpers defined in `handlers_core.go`.\n- `isUniqueViolation` and `isForeignKeyViolation` centralize detection of SQLite unique/foreign-key failures so handlers can translate them into 409/404 responses with domain-specific messages.\n- `requireCampaign` loads a campaign and writes the standard 404 response if it is missing or the load fails. It is used by any handler that needs to validate a `/v1/campaigns/{id}` path parameter.\n- `handlers_play.go` contains `authenticate` (Bearer `session-<username>` validation) and `requirePlayCampaign` (loads the play surface campaign with the standard 400/404 response). Auth failures are written with `authFail` from `handlers_core.go`.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n1. **Core rules** (`/v1/dice/*`, `/v1/checks/*`, `/v1/encounters/*`, `/v1/initiative/*`, `/v1/characters/*`) — pure, deterministic calculations with no persistence. Dice handlers compute min/max/average rather than rolling.\n2. **Auth** (`/v1/auth/*`) — password hashing with bcrypt; returns deterministic `session-<username>` tokens.\n3. **Combat** (`/v1/combat/*`) — initiative order, conditions, and turn advancement persisted to SQLite and mirrored in memory.\n4. **Storage** (`/v1/storage/*`) — introspects the SQLite driver/schema and can reset the database to a clean schema while preserving users.\n5. **Compendium** (`/v1/compendium/*`) — CRUD for monsters and items; tags are stored in a child table.\n6. **Campaigns** (`/v1/campaigns/*`) — campaigns, characters, events, audit, export, and aggregated state.\n7. **Campaign analytics** (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/*`) — deterministic readiness score and risk report.\n8. **Session scheduling** (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/*`) — scheduled play sessions and attendance.\n9. **Inventory and equipment** (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory/*`) — party inventory and per-character equipment assignment.\n10. **Downtime crafting** (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/*`) — crafting projects that advance days and produce items on completion.\n11. **Quest tracking** (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/*`) — quests with milestones and status aggregation.\n12. **NPCs and factions** (`/v1/campaigns/{id}/factions/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships`) — relationship map and friendly-NPC counts.\n13. **Player's Handbook rules** (`/v1/phb/*`) — spell slots, long rests, and encumbrance.\n14. **DM tools** (`/v1/dm/*`) — encounter builder, loot parcels, and session recap hooks that scan the latest event summary.\n15. **Play surface** (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`) — authenticated campaign lifecycle (create, join, start), narrations, turn queue, player actions, GM resolutions, nudges, GM status, owner/player campaign documents with DM-note filtering, and owner-managed location graph.\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n- All files belong to `package main`. The project is deliberately kept as a single package to avoid exposing internal symbols unnecessarily.\n- Keep handlers grouped by domain in the existing `handlers_*.go` files. Add a new file only when a domain is large enough to warrant its own boundary.\n- Pure calculation logic belongs in `rules.go`; persistence logic belongs in `db.go`; types and shared constants belong in `models.go`.\n- All JSON responses are produced via `writeJSON` so the `Content-Type` header and encoding error logging are consistent.\n- Status codes are part of the observable contract: use `http.StatusOK` for successful reads, `http.StatusCreated` for successful creation, and the standard 400/401/403/404/409 helpers for errors.\n- Unique-constraint failures are detected with `isUniqueViolation`; foreign-key failures are detected with `isForeignKeyViolation`. Avoid duplicating the raw SQLite error string in individual handlers.\n- Map iteration order is non-deterministic. Avoid relying on it for any response field that tests compare exactly. Use explicit `ORDER BY` clauses in SQL and sort slices where needed.\n- The service is deterministic by design: dice handlers compute min/max/average; bcrypt uses the default cost; no randomness is used. Do not introduce `math/rand` or non-deterministic sources.\n- All database mutations should be performed inside a transaction when they touch more than one table. Existing helpers in `db.go` already follow this pattern; new helpers should too.\n- The in-memory caches (`users`, `combat`) are protected by mutexes. Always hold the appropriate lock before reading or writing the cached map.\n- Add unit tests for pure helpers in `rules.go` (see `rules_test.go` for examples). Keep tests deterministic and do not require an external network or running server.\n- To test locally, start the server with `./run.sh` and use `curl` against `http://127.0.0.1:$PORT`. err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc loadUsers() error {\n\trows, err := db.Query(\"SELECT username, password_hash, role FROM users\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tusers.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer users.mu.Unlock()\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar u user\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&u.Username, &u.PasswordHash, &u.Role); AND campaign_id = ?\n\t\t)\n\t\tORDER BY initiative DESC, name ASC, kind ASC`,\n\t\tencounterID, campaignID, encounterID, campaignID,\n\t)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tvar order []encounterTurnEntry\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar e encounterTurnEntry\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&e.Name, &e.Kind, &e.Initiative, &e.Member, &e.TargetID); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\torder = append(order, e)\n\t}\n\treturn order, rows.Err()\n}\n\n// dbGetPlayEncounterActive returns the currently active combatant for the\n// encounter along with the stored round and turn index. It verifies that the caller is either the\n// campaign owner or the current combatant; otherwise it returns ok=false. The\n// new active combatant is returned on success.\nfunc dbAdvancePlayEncounterTurn(campaignID, encounterID, caller string, isOwner bool) (*encounterTurnEntry, int, int, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar round, turnIndex int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT round, turn_index FROM play_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID, encounterID,\n\t).Scan(&round, &turnIndex)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, err\n\t}\n\n\torder, err := dbGetPlayEncounterTurnOrderTx(tx, campaignID, encounterID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, err\n\t}\n\tif len(order) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif turnIndex < 0 || turnIndex >= len(order) {\n\t\tturnIndex = 0\n\t}\n\n\tif !isOwner {\n\t\tactive := order[turnIndex]\n\t\tif active.Kind != \"member\" || active.Member != caller {\n\t\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, nil\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tnextIndex := turnIndex + 1\n\tnextRound := round\n\tif nextIndex >= len(order) {\n\t\tnextIndex = 0\n\t\tnextRound++\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"UPDATE play_encounters SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?\",\n\t\tnextRound, nextIndex, campaignID, encounterID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Decrement conditions on the newly active combatant at the start of its turn.\n\t// Conditions that reach 0 remaining rounds are removed.\n\tif nextIndex >= 0 && nextIndex < len(order) {\n\t\tif _, err := dbDecrementPlayEncounterConditionsTx(tx, campaignID, encounterID, order[nextIndex].TargetID); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, 0, 0, false, err\n\t}\n\treturn &order[nextIndex], nextRound, nextIndex, true, nil\n}\n\n// dbCreatePlayEncounterCondition adds a named condition to a target combatant\n// in a play encounter. It returns\n// ok=false when the character is not found in the campaign.\nfunc dbApplyCharacterDamage(campaignID, characterID string, amount int) (*damageResponse, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tm, err := dbGetPlayMembershipByCharacterIDTx(tx, campaignID, characterID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tif m == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\tafter := m.HPCurrent - amount\n\tif after < 0 {\n\t\tafter = 0\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := dbUpdateMemberHP(tx, campaignID, m.Username, after); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn &damageResponse{\n\t\tTarget:   characterID,\n\t\tHPBefore: m.HPCurrent,\n\t\tHPAfter:  after,\n\t\tDamage:   amount,\n\t}, true, nil\n}\n\n// dbRecordDeathSave records a success or failure for an unconscious character\n// and updates its life state accordingly. It returns ok=false when the\n// character is not found, and conflict=true when the character is not\n// unconscious.\nfunc dbRecordDeathSave(campaignID, characterID, outcome string) (*deathSavesResponse, bool, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tm, err := dbGetPlayMembershipByCharacterIDTx(tx, campaignID, characterID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, false, err\n\t}\n\tif m == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\tif m.Status != characterStatusUnconscious {\n\t\treturn nil, false, true, nil\n\t}\n\n\tsuccesses, failures := m.Successes, m.Failures\n\tstatus := m.Status\n\tif outcome == \"success\" {\n\t\tsuccesses++\n\t\tif successes >= 3 {\n\t\t\tstatus = characterStatusStable\n\t\t}\n\t} else if outcome == \"failure\" {\n\t\tfailures++\n\t\tif failures >= 3 {\n\t\t\tstatus = characterStatusDead\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"UPDATE play_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND character_id = ?\",\n\t\tsuccesses, failures, status, campaignID, characterID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, false, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn &deathSavesResponse{\n\t\tCharacterID: characterID,\n\t\tSuccesses:   successes,\n\t\tFailures:    failures,\n\t\tStatus:      status,\n\t}, true, false, nil\n}\n\n// dbCreatePlayEncounterMonster adds a deterministic monster combatant to an\n// encounter. AND campaign_id = ?\",\n\t\tcharacterID, campaignID,\n\t).Scan(&m.Username, &m.Name, &m.Class, &m.HPCurrent, &m.HPMax, &m.Status, &m.Successes, &m.Failures)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn m, nil\n}\n\n// resolveMemberStatus determines the new life state for a member after an\n// HP change. Dead characters remain dead; zero HP makes a living character\n// unconscious; positive HP makes a living character conscious and clears\n// death-save counters.\nfunc resolveMemberStatus(currentStatus string, hp int) (newStatus string, resetCounters bool) {\n\tif currentStatus == characterStatusDead {\n\t\treturn characterStatusDead, false\n\t}\n\tif hp <= 0 {\n\t\treturn characterStatusUnconscious, false\n\t}\n\treturn characterStatusConscious, true\n}\n\n// dbUpdateMemberHP applies an HP change to a member and keeps the life state\n// in sync. It returns the resulting status.\nfunc dbUpdateMemberHP(tx *sql.Tx, campaignID, username string, hp int) (string, error) {\n\tvar status string\n\terr := tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT status FROM play_members WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID, username,\n\t).Scan(&status)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\n\tnewStatus, resetCounters := resolveMemberStatus(status, hp)\n\tif resetCounters {\n\t\t_, err = tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t\"UPDATE play_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ?, death_save_successes = 0, death_save_failures = 0 WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n\t\t\thp, newStatus, campaignID, username,\n\t\t)\n\t} else {\n\t\t_, err = tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t\"UPDATE play_members SET hp_current = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?\",\n\t\t\thp, newStatus, campaignID, username,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t}\n\treturn newStatus, nil\n}\n\n// dbGetPlayMembersByCampaign returns the usernames of all members in a play\n// campaign, sorted deterministically by join order (insertion rowid).\nfunc dbGetPlayMembersByCampaign(campaignID string) ([]string, error) {\n\trows, err := db.Query(\n\t\t\"SELECT username FROM play_members WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY rowid ASC\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tvar usernames []string\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar username string\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&username); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tusernames = append(usernames, username)\n\t}\n\treturn usernames, rows.Err()\n}\n\n// dbGetPlayMemberSummariesByCampaign returns the full party member summaries\n// for a play campaign, ordered deterministically by join order (insertion rowid).\nfunc dbGetPlayMemberSummariesByCampaign(campaignID string) ([]playMembership, error) {\n\trows, err := db.Query(\n\t\t\"SELECT username, character_id, name, class, hp_current, hp_max, status, death_save_successes, death_save_failures FROM play_members WHERE campaign_id = ? If any locations exist, the first location by\n// insertion order is adopted as the party's current location. The caller is\n// responsible for verifying the campaign is still in the lobby state and has\n// enough members.\nfunc dbStartPlayCampaign(campaignID, currentActor string) error {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar firstLoc sql.NullString\n\tif err := tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT id FROM play_locations WHERE campaign_id = ? AND status = 'lobby'\",\n\t\t\tcurrentActor, firstLoc.String, campaignID,\n\t\t)\n\t} else {\n\t\t_, err = tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t\"UPDATE play_campaigns SET status = 'active', current_actor = ?, turn_number = 1 WHERE id = ? The caller must\n// already have verified the caller is the owner.\nfunc dbNudge(campaignID, message string) (string, int, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar status string\n\tvar actor sql.NullString\n\tvar nudgeCount int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT status, current_actor, nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&status, &actor, &nudgeCount)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\tif status != campaignStatusActive {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\tvar nextSeq int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&nextSeq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n\t\tcampaignID, nextSeq, \"nudge\", \"dm\", \"\", message,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = nudge_count + 1 WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\treturn actor.String, nudgeCount + 1, true, nil\n}\n\n// dbCreateAction appends a player action event to a play campaign, advances the\n// turn pointer to the DM, and returns the public action response. If the\n// campaign is not active or the caller is not the current actor, it returns\n// ok=false and no error.\nfunc dbCreateAction(campaignID, username string, req *actionRequest) (*actionResponse, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar status, owner string\n\tvar actor sql.NullString\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT status, owner, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&status, &owner, &actor)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tif status != campaignStatusActive || actor.String != username {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\tvar nextSeq int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&nextSeq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n\t\tcampaignID, nextSeq, \"action\", username, req.Type, req.Text,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = turn_number + 1 WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\towner, campaignID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn &actionResponse{\n\t\tSequence:  nextSeq,\n\t\tKind:      \"action\",\n\t\tActor:     username,\n\t\tType:      req.Type,\n\t\tText:      req.Text,\n\t\tNextActor: \"dm\",\n\t}, true, nil\n}\n\n// dbCreateTravel appends a travel event to a play campaign and advances the\n// turn pointer to the DM.
